# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in contributing to this project!

* [How to contribute](/HOWTOCONTRIBUTE.md): how to claim an issue, add a new algorithm, report and fix a defect, and write a section of the book.
* [Code of Conduct](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): everyone taking part in this project is expected to follow it.
* [Discussions](https://github.com/ShisatoYano/AutonomousVehicleControlBeginnersGuide/discussions): ask questions and share ideas here. Issues are for bug reports and agreed tasks.
